Message:
drm: use mem_is_zero() instead of !memchr_inv(s, 0, n)

Use the mem_is_zero() helper where possible.

Conversion done using cocci:

| @@
| expression PTR;
| expression SIZE;
| @@
|
|   <...
| (
| - memchr_inv(PTR, 0, SIZE) == NULL
| + mem_is_zero(PTR, SIZE)
| |
| - !memchr_inv(PTR, 0, SIZE)
| + mem_is_zero(PTR, SIZE)
| |
| - memchr_inv(PTR, 0, SIZE)
| + !mem_is_zero(PTR, SIZE)
| )
|   ...>
